system.description:
Touch; one creature or object for 1 hour per level. Divination spells (scrying, locating, detecting) targeting it fail if of 3rd level or lower; for higher levels the caster makes a casting check (d20 + casting-stat modifier + half its level) vs DC 10 + the spell's level, failing means the spell fails. Material: diamond dust worth 50 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Illusionist, Warlock, Bard, Magus
